holder-quote: This time Erin felt and heard something crunch in her hands. She didn’t care. She punched again.
effect-quote: Her right hand broke. Erin cried out as she felt her fingers break.

holder-quote: One of the Goblins moved. Erin whirled.
That was easy. Toren charged, dropping his sword. Erin turned. He leapt at her, and she punched.
effect-quote: This time her fist snapped his ribs.

holder-quote: By not needing him. Toren rolled as Erin threw him. In the mud, they fought each other, trying to knock each other down, get up. How could he hurt her as much as she hurt him?
Those are the Beriad. It means, to our people, in our tongue—away.
